profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with most of my experience being in the banking/crypto spaces.  I love building comprehensible and performant user interfaces as well as the API's that go along with them.  

Most of my experience has been on the frontend with Typescript and React but working at startups the scope of "frontend" begins to grow quickly!  So I also have experience writing in Elixir, Python, and Go.

projects.title: RUMBL
projects.description:
- Using Elixir, Phoenix, and LiveView, I created an application that allows users to upload videos and leave timestamped comments on other users videos.  
- I have utilized forms in LiveView and Ecto changesets to gather information, validate this info, and persist the data to the Postgres DB
- Authentication is being handled by hashing passwords with pbkdf2_elixir then persisting the the DB
- I've also written tests for the views, controllers, and business layer
